release_notes: Mandatory OPS Android 4.5.26 Task photo React zoom fix. Failed local Task photos no longer render a full-card Retry/Delete overlay. The captured image remains the primary tappable control in every phase and opens the existing MediaLightbox for full-screen zoom; failure text, Retry and Delete render in a separate block below the image. The obsolete CSS overlay workaround has been removed. Native Task photo capture and D1 registration flow are unchanged. No D1 migration or backfill.
